title: The Architect: Interactive Visualization of Deep Learning Mathematics Directly in Microsoft Excel
abstract: arXiv:2608.13572v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present The Architect, a system that turns Microsoft Excel into an interactive view of deep learning mathematics. A user describes a neural network in a compact table. The system then generates a workbook that shows the full forward pass and, when requested, the backward pass and parameter updates. Computed values appear as live spreadsheet formulas, while user-controlled values such as inputs, weights, labels, and hyperparameters remain editable. Excel reactively updates the dependent computations through its recalculation engine.   Most deep learning tools hide the numerical details behind library calls. Many visualization tools show architecture diagrams or training summaries, but they do not expose the full arithmetic of the model. The Architect focuses on that missing middle layer. It makes matrices, activations, losses, gradients, and updates visible as inspectable spreadsheet regions, with editable controls for values users n

translated_title: 《架构师》：直接在Microsoft Excel中交互式可视化深度学习数学
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13572v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们提出了“架构师”系统，该系统将Microsoft Excel转变为深度学习数学的交互式视图。用户以紧凑表格形式描述神经网络，系统随后生成一个工作簿，展示完整的前向传播，并在请求时展示反向传播和参数更新。计算值以实时电子表格公式形式出现，而用户控制的值（如输入、权重、标签和超参数）保持可编辑状态。Excel通过其重新计算引擎响应式更新依赖计算。大多数深度学习工具将数值细节隐藏在库调用背后。许多可视化工具显示架构图或训练摘要，但未暴露模型的完整算术过程。“架构师”专注于这一缺失的中间层。它使矩阵、激活函数、损失、梯度和更新以可检查的电子表格区域形式可见，并为用户可调整的值提供可编辑控件。
tldr: 该论文提出“架构师”系统，将Excel转化为交互式深度学习数学可视化工具，使前向传播、反向传播及参数更新的完整计算过程以可编辑的电子表格公式形式透明呈现。
en_tdlr: This paper presents "The Architect," a system that turns Excel into an interactive deep learning math visualization tool, making full forward/backward passes and parameter updates transparently visible as editable spreadsheet formulas.
